policy: A question is VERIFIED_PYQ only after its exact wording, options, exam/year/paper, and official answer are checked against authoritative evidence. An official portal URL alone is not per-question verification.

sources.notes: SSC question/response-sheet and answer-key access may be login- and time-limited. A generic SSC homepage is not sufficient evidence for an individual question. Store an item-specific official reference and answer-key evidence when available.

Official information handouts establish exam format, not that an item appeared in an actual previous paper. Handout/sample questions must not be labelled VERIFIED_PYQ without item-specific past-paper evidence.

question_bank_audit.result: No item in these source-code banks has been verified against an exact official paper and official answer key in this audit. Do not seed any of these records as VERIFIED_PYQ.
